kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Clipping of نَشَاسْتَج (našāstaj), from the Middle Persian word behind Classical Persian نشاسته (nišāsta). Compare مِينَا (mīnā), مِينَاء (mīnāʔ) for the trailing variation.
See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.

kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نشا (form I)
# نَشَّا (naššā) /naʃ.ʃaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of نَشَّ (našša)
# نِشَّا (niššā) /niʃ.ʃaː/: second-person dual imperative of نَشَّ (našša)

أَنْشَوِ • (ʔanšawi) (form VII) /ʔan.ʃa.wi/
# first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْشَوَى (inšawā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.

kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تَنِشِّي • (taniššī) (form I) /ta.niʃ.ʃiː/
# second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of نَشَّ (našša)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
